Wongo: 1,000 puzzles / 1 000 hlavolamov

A4 landscape, 100% / actual size, no margins or headers. Duplex: flip on SHORT edge. 500 pages = 250 sheets. Cut in half after checking one sheet. Easy fronts, hard backs. Back slots are deliberately reversed for duplex alignment.

A4 na šírku, mierka 100 %, bez okrajov a hlavičiek. Obojstranne: otáčať po KRATŠEJ hrane. 500 strán = 250 listov. Najprv overte jeden list, potom rozstrihnite na polovicu.
